description: This file contains helper functions for testing a parallel checkout process in a version control system, including configuration, execution, and verification of checkout workers.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Sets the checkout configuration by specifying the number of workers and the parallelism threshold.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Runs a command with a specified number of checkout workers and verifies the number of worker processes used during execution.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies that the checkout has been correctly performed by checking the git status and diff in the specified repository.
